q: In the thermodynamic formalism (Ruelle), the pressure function P(f,φ) = sup_μ[h_μ(f) + ∫φ dμ] for φ=0 gives:
opts: The measure-theoretic entropy of the MME
exp: P(f,0) = sup_μ h_μ(f) = h_top(f) by the variational principle. The pressure P(f,φ) is the Legendre transform of the entropy function — a direct analogy with free energy in statistical mechanics (F = U - TS corresponds to -P = -h - ∫φ dμ).
